rationale: Reference close: 7,415.50, the settled cash close of Monday 27 July 2026, the last completed S&P 500 cash session (16:30-23:00 broker = 09:30-16:00 ET) strictly before the report date. Fork selection: the report itself consolidates the medium-term regime as RANGE (overlap 0.43, directional persistence 0.22, mid-range position, Kaufman efficiency -0.06 against a 0.13 trend threshold, volatility slope flat-to-contracting), so the range fork is mandatory and the momentum-pullback and breakout forks are not available even though the report's own card was built with pullback machinery. Range definition, from the 25 cash sessions ending at D-1: high 7,582.80 set on 2026-07-15, low 7,303.10 set on 2026-06-26, width 279.70 points. The reference close sits at 40.2% of that width, in the lower half, so the fade order that price can actually reach is the buy at the lower band - the upper sell band (78.6-88.6% = 7,522.94 to 7,550.90) sits 107 to 135 points above the close, more than 1.4 x ATR14 away, against 53 to 81 points for the buy band. Entry: the long band is 11.4% to 21.4% of width above the low, i.e. 7,334.99 to 7,362.96. The card takes 7,362.96, the 21.4% edge, for two reasons: it is the edge nearest to price and therefore the first touch of the band, and it is the only part of the band that satisfies the risk-envelope test below. Entry is 52.54 points below the 7,415.50 reference close, the correct side for a buy limit. Stop: inside the lower boundary by 10% of range width, 7,303.10 + 27.97 = 7,331.07. Risk = 7,362.96 - 7,331.07 = 31.89 points = 0.43 x ATR14 on the cash basis and 0.38 x ATR14 on the full-broker-day basis, inside the 0.3 to 3.0 envelope on both and below the 1 x ATR14 wide-stop threshold. Note the rebuild this forced: a mid-band fill near 7,349 against the same rule-fixed stop gives risk of only about 17.9 points, 0.24 x ATR14 on the cash basis and 0.21 on the full-day basis, which is outside the envelope and is a rebuild condition rather than a warning; moving the fill to the top of the permitted band is the only adjustment the rule allows, since the stop offset and the band width are both fixed. Targets: TP1 is the range midpoint, 7,303.10 + 0.50 x 279.70 = 7,442.95, which is 79.99 points from entry, 1.09 x ATR14 and well inside the 2.5 x ATR14 reachability cap; TP2 is the far side less 10% of width, 7,582.80 - 27.97 = 7,554.83; TP3 is null because the third unit is a structural breakout runner trailed on swing structure rather than a priced target.
